description: This file defines asynchronous functions for managing certification jobs, including creation, retrieval, patching, status updates, and related database operations within a certification management system. It interacts with SQLAlchemy ORM models and external repository adapters.

methods.name: CertificationJob create_certification_job(session: AsyncSession, req: TriggerCertificationRequest)
methods.description: Creates a new certification job, resolves repo info via adapter, and initializes related result records.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] get_certification_job_by_run_id(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a certification job from the database using its run ID.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] patch_certification_job(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str, patch: PatchCertificationRequest)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing certification job based on provided patch data.

methods.name: List[BranchEnvironmentMapping] list_mappings(session: AsyncSession, provider: Optional[str] = None, project_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists branch-environment mappings with optional filtering by provider and project ID.

methods.name: BranchEnvironmentMapping create_mapping(session: AsyncSession, item: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new branch-environment mapping record.

methods.name: List[MetadataItem] list_metadata(session: AsyncSession, filters: Dict[str, Optional[str]])
methods.description: Retrieves metadata items with optional filters such as provider, project ID, branch, and key.

methods.name: MetadataItem upsert_metadata(session: AsyncSession, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts or updates a metadata item based on specified scope and key.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] update_result_state_by_webhook(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str, cert_type: Optional[CertificationType], state: str, logs_url: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates the status of certification results based on webhook payload, and updates aggregate job status.
